text.en: Vent shaft should be just through that bulkhead. ...Right where Mothma's schematics marked it. Lock that route in your head, Tuk. You're gonna need an exit.
Command hub's gotta be just past this bulkhead. Keep your head down.
Bingo. Let's see which cell block they're stashing our defector in...
Drek. There go the sirens. Right—back to the vent. Just don't let it lead to waste disposal. I hate waste disposal.
